item.title: MySQLDump - MySQL database backup
item.description:
Using the mysqldump tool, you can back up a local database and restore it to a remote database with the same characteristics, all using a simple command. Next, you’ll see practical examples of using the mysqldump tool to export and import MySQL databases.

Below is an export example:

1

$ mysqldump -u [USERNAME] -p[PASSWORD] [DATABASE-NAME] > dumpfilename.sql

And to import the database:

1

$ mysql -u [USERNAME] -p[PASSWORD] [DATABASE-NAME] < dumpfilename.sql

item.title: Installing ZeosLib in Delphi XE2
item.description:
After having difficulty installing ZeosLib in Delphi XE2, I decided to share “the way through”.

The ZeosLib Library

The ZeosLib library consists of a set of tools so you can have a native database connection, meaning a connection without auxiliary drivers such as ODBC.

ZeosLib is an open-source project, its installation isn’t that complex, but here’s the recipe, just follow the steps without skipping “any ingredient”.
